name: aks-secure-baseline
description: Private AKS cluster with Azure CNI overlay + Cilium, Azure RBAC, workload identity, a Premium registry with AcrPull, and Container Insights.
what: A private AKS cluster running Azure CNI overlay with the Cilium dataplane and network policy, local accounts disabled, Entra/Azure-RBAC authentication, OIDC + workload identity, the Key Vault secrets provider, and Container Insights. A system-assigned kubelet identity is granted AcrPull on a Premium Azure Container Registry.
why: Hand-rolled Kubernetes security drifts quickly. This codifies the Microsoft AKS secure-baseline guidance — private API server, no local accounts, managed identity image pulls, and workload identity — so every cluster starts compliant.
potentialUseCases: Standardized landing zone for microservices platforms
Regulated container workloads needing a private API server
Multi-team cluster with Azure RBAC namespace isolation
Workload-identity-based access to Key Vault, SQL, and storage

reliability: System node pool spread across availability zones (prod)
Standard tier control plane with uptime SLA in prod
security: Private API server with no public endpoint
Local accounts disabled; Entra + Azure RBAC only
Workload identity (OIDC) instead of long-lived secrets
Image pulls via managed identity AcrPull, no registry credentials
Cilium network policy enforces pod-to-pod segmentation
costOptimization: Free control plane tier and single small node in dev
Autoscaler scales the node pool to demand
operationalExcellence: Container Insights streams to Log Analytics
Key Vault secrets provider with rotation enabled
Managed cluster upgrades with surge settings
performanceEfficiency: Cilium eBPF dataplane for high-throughput networking
Overlay networking conserves VNet address space

quota.summary: The AKS system-node pool needs available VM (vCPU) quota for the chosen size's family in the target region. The registry and monitoring have no blocking regional quota.

requirements.detail: The system node pool needs vCPU quota for the selected VM size's family (e.g. DSv5) in the region. New subscriptions often start at 0 for a family and must request quota.

cost.profile: Prod profile: Standard tier control plane, 3x D4s_v5 nodes, Premium ACR.

components.name: AKS control plane (Standard tier)
components.notes: Per-cluster uptime SLA charge (Free tier in dev).
